summary: backup.yml now proves a staged backup secret_id with an AppRole login at the VIP before installing it. A 400 fails naming -e openbao_rotate_secret_ids=true, a 403 'permission denied' (no AppRole mount) reports it undelivered, and anything else fails with the status and error text. The login's token is revoked via revoke-self, which the backup policy now grants. Tested against an OpenBao 2.5.4 dev server; ansible gate green.
